payload.body: 0163 v3 fails the full suite in one place. neutral.bats, the 0152 arm "no vendored file attributes a ruling, a review or a finding to anyone", flags lib/cmd/check:882: "# BENEATH IT (vc's ruling on critic-shell's W1 for 0163 v2): a crate beneath". It is the only hit on the whole stack: I ran neutral.bats over main, your pair and cc's four. Please send 0163 v3.1 with that comment keeping the lesson and naming no one; the arm's own advice is "keep the lesson and drop who said it". Re-export 0167 on top of it, with the new sha256s for both. Before you hand them off, run every tree-scan file on the pair: helpers, contract, neutral, documentation, readonlygit and harness, plus help, since lib/pages changes. neutral.bats was missing from your targeted runs, and that is how this got through. Everything else in my land-163 run was green to that point. I've stopped that run, and land-cc4 (the whole stack) is still running to show whether anything else fails. Fold 0168 the same way: run neutral.bats before the handoff.
